units: <cite ref="Arakhin 25a:23">Arakh. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>כור זרע … במ׳ יד</he> we assess the value of a field by the quantity of seed … which it takes when strewing with the hand, opp. to <he>מ׳ שוורים</he> strewing from a perforated bag or wagon drawn by oxen; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 105b">B. Mets. 105ᵇ</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:4:13">Y. Ber. III, 6ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>במפלת יד</he> with one and the same throw.
<cite ref="Berakhot 3a:15">Ber. 3ᵃ</cite>, sq. you must not enter a ruined building for prayer <he>מפני המ׳</he> because it may fall in.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 16:3:3">Y. Sabb. XVI, 15ᵈ</cite> top <he>מצילין … מיד המ׳</he> we must save (on the Sabbath) … persons buried under debris.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 2:3">Pes. II, 3</cite> <he>חמץ שנפלה עליו מ׳</he> leavened matter covered with debris; a. fr.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:1:3">Y. Ber. V, beg. 8ᵈ</cite> <he>במ׳ של מחריביו חתם</he> Jeremiah closed with prophesying the downfall of the destroyers of the Temple; (<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:15">Midr. Till. to Ps. IV</cite> <he>במַפַּלְתָּן</he>).
